dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, thick white fringes creating sharp boundaries against dark brown-to-black feather centers across the scapulars and visible coverts.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A gradual transition from finer, dense spotting on the crown/nape to larger, broader scalloping on the mantle, lacking a distinct linear boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high-contrast, repetitive 'U'-shaped pale margins across the entire dorsal surface, creating a heavily imbricated visual effect.
